---
title: "01-data-download"
editor: visual
---

I need data

http://owl.fish.washington.edu/nightingales/P_generosa/EPI-209_S29_L004_R1_001.fastq.gz


Load data from internet

```{bash}
pwd
cd ../data/raw

curl -O http://owl.fish.washington.edu/nightingales/P_generosa/EPI-209_S29_L004_R1_001.fastq.gz

```

Unzip file

```{bash}
gunzip ../data/raw/EPI-209_S29_L004_R1_001.fastq.gz
```




Look at first 10 lines of data to make sure it looks

```{bash}
head ../data/raw/EPI-209_S29_L004_R1_001.fastq
```
